title: Anonymous server action mutation
gold: Identify actions.ts:3 as an unauthenticated and unauthorized mutation.
UI hiding is not a server authorization boundary.
Test anonymous, other-tenant admin, same-tenant member and allowed tenant admin.
Secure twin must deny unauthorized requests without side effects and retain allowed deletion.

rubric.pass_if: Names the direct server action and missing identity/object policy.
Requires server-derived tenant and role, not login alone.
Asserts unchanged data on denial and valid administrator success.

anti_patterns: Treating middleware or hidden UI as sufficient.
source: Original synthetic fixture derived from security research section 5f and Next.js authentication guidance.
